what: The command post's on-device read of a sighting note (Read the note, ONLY_ON_DEVICE) on the deployed site with the browser tab offline. One made-up drill note, read twice in the same open form; the sighting was cancelled, never saved.
browser: Stephen's Google Chrome 157.0.8103.80 on this Mac (macOS, Apple M5 Pro); the built-in model's availability check for English text reported "available"; the model folder on disk (OptGuideOnDeviceModel) is 2025.8.8.1141
page: The deployed command post, https://buildhybridai-2026-yg3m.web.app/?incident=drill-test-1, build commit 1b7d3571 (bundle /assets/main-CQsIXPgo.js), signed in to the test drill drill-test-1 as command; App Check as on the live site
offline: The tab was set to Offline in Chrome DevTools (Network throttling) before the reads. A same-origin fetch of /version.json failed with "TypeError: Failed to fetch" just before each read (22:15:23Z and 22:17:15Z). navigator.onLine stayed true under this per-tab setting, so the failed fetches are the proof, not onLine.
